23march01.text:
Happy Women's Day!

March 8th, marks International Women's Day, a day dedicated to celebrating women's achievements, recognizing the challenges they face and continuing to seek gender equality for a better tomorrow.

There's so many great women out there and we wanted to celebrate a few of them specifically by creating a game inspired by their accomplishments.

First up is a Grand Slam champion who has poured her heart and soul into her sport, and has pushed her boundaries to the limit. Are you down for a friendly match with Serena Williams?

How to play:

- The match will last for 45 seconds.
- You have 2 seconds to reach the ball and throw it back at her by stepping on the arrow tile.
- Don't let the tiles turn red or you'll lose. Good luck!
23march01.title: Happy Women's Day!
23march02.text:
Happy Women's Day!

Marie Curie is a symbol of the achievements of women in science. Even though she had to face discrimination because of her gender, her work paved the way for future generations of women in science.

 She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and the first person ever to win two Nobel Prizes in different fields. Even to this day she's still an inspiration for women around the world to follow their passions and make their mark on the world.

Travel back in time and help Marie Curie complete the new experiment she's working on. Do you think you know enough about science to be her new lab partner?

How to play:

- Marie Curie will ask you to find the items she needs for her experiment by asking you a series of science questions.
- Once you know the answer and have found the item in the room, you'll need to walk towards it and stand near it until she gives you the next set of instructions.
- You have 1:30 minute to help her find all the items she needs for her experiment. Good luck!
23march02.title: Happy Women's Day!
23march03.text:
We bring you a new puzzle game where you'll need to program a robot to follow the instructions you give him. The goal is to make the robot collect all the coins in order to complete each level.

 There are 3 possible actions for the bot to do:

 - Go forward
- Rotate to the right
- Rotate to the left

 By clicking the boxes you can select the action and the color to form the instructions. The colors you can select are:

 - White (any color)
- Red
- Blue
- Green

 *Examples*

 :RED + RIGHT ARROW ---> If the robot is on a red tile, it will rotate to the right.
WHITE + FORWARD ARROW ---> On any color, go forward.

 When you've set up the order you want the robot to move, click on the boxes on Module 1 or 2 to place the instructions there.

 The robot will follow the instructions in order, starting from the line 1.
You can repeat the cycle of instructions by putting the block number "1" 
You can execute the instructions on Module 2 by putting the block number "2" 

 *Examples*:

 RED + 2 ---> If the robot is on a red tile, execute the instructions in Module 2.
WHITE + 1 ---> On any color, restart the cycle from the first instruction.

 Make sure to be wearing the badge from the previous level before stepping on the arrow tile in order to continue.

You can get a free tutorial on the robozzle's website, from which this game is inspired by. It may be a bit challenging at first but when you start solving the puzzles you won't want to stop!

 [https://i.imgur.com/yS4ETCB.gif|*] [https://i.imgur.com/yS4ETCB.gif| Check out] this gif on how to play.
23march03.title: HabboZZle
23may01.text: Race against the strange creatures that live in the deepest parts of the ocean and win some exclusive badges while you're at it!How to play: - Race towards the green tiles and step on them to win points.- Every time you pull one of the levers you will let one of the sea monsters out which will make the game harder since they will come after you, but at the same time you'll get more points for each time that you step on the green tile.    0 animals in the field: 1 point per green tile    1 animal in the field: 2 points per green tile    2 animals in the field: 3 points per green tile    3 animals in the field: 5 points per green tile    4(all) animals in the field: 8 points per green tile- For every sea monster that you dare to release into the game; you'll get an extra 3 points. Releasing all 4 will get you 12 points.Prizes:- If you manage to get 150 points you'll get a Sea Monster Hunter badge.- But if you manage to get 250 points you'll win a Sea Monster Champion badge and a Jasper Baby Penguin.Good luck!
23may01.title: Sea Beasts!
24RubberDuck1.text: Who doesn't like rubber duckies? We all do, especially in Habbo. There are so many different type of duckies in Habbo. Let's put them in the spot light!In every room you will find a painting with a lot of ducks. Each painting shows 1 duck that does not belong in the painting. Find this duck and click on it. You have 15 seconds to find it.When you have found the duck, you automatically proceed to the next game. There are 3 levels. After 3 levels you win an exclusive badge!
24RubberDuck1.title: 24RubberDuck1.title
24chess1.text: Where strategy meets virtual fun! Challenge your friends while sharpening your chess skills. Move your pieces strategically in order to eat your opponent's King within the 10 min timeframe.Outsmart your opponents for a chance to win an exclusive badge!
24chess1.title: Habbo's Chess Game
24circus01.text:
Magicians Mayhem!

So, you're trying to earn your spot as one of the circus crew? You're in luck! They're just starting their tour in Habbo and need some help getting everything ready for their big opening.
To join them, you'll first need to prove you are circus material by completing a series of tasks they have in store.
Your first task will be to help Silvan the magician gather all the tools he needs for his show. Are you up for the task?

How to play:
- Listen to what Silvan has to tell you and answer **yes** if you are willing to help him out.
- Read carefully all the items he needs you to get for him and start walking around the game area to collect them by saying **picks** when standing next to them.
- Watch out for the Bouncers that will appear, they don't know you are helping Silvan and will kick anyone they consider to be intruders.
- When you've collected all the items, go back to the fence entrance and say **done!** to collect your prizes.
24circus01.title: Cirque Du Pixels!
24circus02.text:
One-Wheel Circus Challenge

The Master Unicyclist isn't entirely convinced of your skills and has challenged you to a unicycle race across the circus arena. It's time to put your balance to the test!
How to play:
- The first person in the queue will be teleported inside the circus, where the Master Unicyclist is waiting.
- Use the red blocks in the middle of the arena to guide your unicycle.
- You need to collect all 3 red balls before reaching the end of the path.
- Watch out for any obstacles along the way.
- Reach the Large Circus Platform before the Master Unicyclist to win the game. Good luck!
24circus02.title: Cirque Du Pixels!
24circus03.text:
Think you're smarter than a mouse? The circus mouse has set a memory challenge for anyone who dares to try it.

How to play:
- Keep an eye on the circus mouse and watch his every move to see the colors he set on the tiles. You better not blink, he moves fast!
- When he's done, set the tiles to the same colors he used. Once you're finished, pull the lever to submit your answer.
- If you guessed correctly, you'll move on to the next room.
24circus03.title: Circus Mouse Memory Challenge
24circus04.text:
Uh-oh! It seems you took the wrong teleport and have found yourself inside the clown's trailer. They're not too keen on having uninvited visitors, so you better get out of there ASAP!

How to play:
- One of the clown's has found you and as you expected he's not too happy.
- Run away from the him for a minute and do not let him catch you or you'll lose.
- If you manage to survive for an entire minute, you'll win the prizes.
24circus04.title: Clown on the Loose!
24circus05.text:
Your time has come to find out once and for all if your circus material or not. Prepare to defy gravity and prove you have what it takes to join the team.

How to play:
- Jump 3 times across the trapeze. Each time the trapeze will move faster so you need to stay laser-focused!
- If you fall off the trapeze 3 times, you'll be eliminated and you'll be teleported back to the queue.
- You have 1 minute to pass the trials. Good luck!
24circus05.title: Circus Stars: Trapeze Trials!
24easter01.text:
Embark on this adventure with Petal, a young botanist on a mission to find long-forgotten existence of magical creatures. Petal has started to research on her own by asking the town's wise elder, Ned, to help her find the ingredients she needs for her quest.

Unfortunately, Ned doesn't know where the ingredients can be found but has pointed towards someone who does: the enigmatic witch, Hecate.

Your first task will be venture into the depths of the forest to find the witch's hidden cottage and get the help you need from her.

How to play:

 - Walk towards Darius and see if he can help you meet the witch Hecate.
 - Find all the roses in the room and step on them to collect them.
 - When you're done, stand in front of the basket and say **create bouquet**
24easter01.title: Fae Farmstead
24easter02.text:
Well done! You've managed to gain access to Hecate's cottage! Now, it's time to complete your mission and get the location of the ingredients Petal needs for her quest.

How to play:

 - There are a total of 3 crystals that can be found in the room.
 - Stand on the tile in front of the crystals and click on them to put them in the safe.
 - When you're done, stand in front of the witch so she can tell you what you need to do next.
24easter02.title: Hecate's Cottage
24easter03.text:
Collecting the right ingredients

After helping Hecate and wondering through the forest, you finally found the right spot where the magic plants grow. To get the right plants for each magical creature, you will need to know the recipes, to be fast and get some help.

How to play:

- With the help of another habbo, both of you will need to collect the right ingredients to create 3 enchanted creatures. Push the lever to know which is the element of the creatures you'll need to find the ingredients for.
- You can only collect the ingredients if both of you are using the right hand item.
- To pick the right hand item, the player on the left will need to go through the one way doors and pick the right seed using the lever. When you get to the seeds of your element, push the green button and get back.
- The player on the right can turn the one way doors by sitting or standing up.
- Give the hand item to your partner on the right and pick another one for you.
- When both of you have the right hand item, look for the ingredients. Step on them and say *** to collect it.
- Repeat this for 3 elements/animals to complete the game.
- When you collect all the ingredients necessary for 3 magical creatures, you and your partner will win the prize for your efforts.
24easter03.title: Dragonfly Farmstead
24easter03a.text:
Finding Ned

Now that you already have all the ingredients necessary to create the enchanted creatures, you need to find Ned to help you to build a device to mix all the ingredients. Finding Ned can be tricky since we loves to walk around. Petal and some villagers saw Ned going to the forest. Can you find him?

How to play:

- Enter the forest and find you way around. Use the arrow teleport.
- Find Ned to win the prize.
24easter03a.title: Dragonfly Farmstead
24easter03b.text:
Finding Ned

You've found Ned's Farm! Now you need to cross the field to the other side.

How to play:

The course is divided in two parts:

First part:
- Don't let the brown chickens get you. They are mad and will chase you back to the beginning.
- The white chickens just block your way.

Second part:
- Only walk when the dog is not looking in your direction, otherwise you are sent back to the middle of the course.
- The goal is to enter the arrow teleport in the Forest Path located on the right-hand side of the room.
24easter03b.title: Dragonfly Farmstead
24easter05.text:
Creating Elemental Creatures

After a long journey, we finnally have all that we need to create the enchanted creatures and restablish the energy balance in the world.
To successfully create the elemental creatures, Petal needs build the "Elemental Fusion Cauldron," a device capable of blending the ingredients and channeling the magical energies needed to bring the creatures to life. With Ned's guidance we can build the device to create all the animals found in the old book.

The game is divided in 2 parts:

How to play:

Part 1: Build the Elemental Fusion Cauldron (You'll have 1:20 to complete it)

- Gather the 4 rocks and bring them towards the campfire.
- After that, you'll need to walk inside each cottage to find the Icky Ooze Jar needed to build the cauldron. Once you've found it bring it ot the campfire and say *.

Part 2: Create the Elemental Creature (You'll have 1 minute to complete it)

- You'll need to create the creature being summoned by the village based on the seeds that will appear in the game.  There are 2 possible options so make sure to look for the right ingredients.
- To gather the ingredients you'll need to walk towards them and bring them to cauldron.
- Ingredients for the *yellow seeds*: 1x Winged Harness (clothing_rainbowwings), 1x Fire Seeds (easter_c24_fireseed) and 1x Astro Bunny (celestial_c19_spacebun)
- Ingredients for the *blue seeds*: 1x Dragonfly Wings (clothing_r20_dragonflywings), 1x Water Seeds (easter_c24_waterseed) and 1x Astro Bunny (celestial_c19_spacebun)
- Once you've collected all the ingredients, stand in front of the cauldron and say * to bring the elemental creature to life.
24easter05.title: Dragonfly Farmstead
24farm01.text:
Spring is here, and what better way to recharge your batteries than in the countryside, observing nature and the animals on the Farm?

How to play:

- The aim of the game is to reproduce the 7 images (fruits, vegetables or animals) in the badges display.
- You have 2 mn 30 sec to reproduce each image.
- The level of difficulty increases from left to right.

- To start, move forward in the queue (click on the green button if you have trouble clicking), then at the end of the queue (when you're the first player), click on the green button again to sit down, and you'll be teleported.
- You then have 10 seconds to choose the drawing of your choice by clicking on the corresponding badge display.

To draw :
- Click on the color of your choice on the palette (12 colors + 1 white to erase), then click on the squares you wish to color on your platform.
- Once you've finished your drawing, click on the flower wagon to validate it.
- If you've made a mistake, a message will appear and you'll be able to fix it if there's time left.

PS : If you want to watch your friends play, say *look*

Good luck!
24farm01.title: The Farm in Colors
24freeze01.text: Gather your friends and prepare to enter an icy arena where every move counts. Are you ready to face the freeze and emerge as the ultimate champion?How to play:- Wait your turn in the roller row. When you reach the end and a new game is available, say a color to choose your team: "red", "blue", "yellow" or "green".- When the game starts, you must eliminate your opponents from the playing field by freezing them. Take every life they have! To throw a snowball you must double click on the freeze boxes.- The winning team will receive a prize and will be able to play again without needing to restart the room.- - For each round you play and win (up to a maximum of 3) you will win an exclusive badge. Freeze your opponents!Note: For a game to start there must be at least two teams with one player on each.
24freeze01.title: Freeze Battle!
24june01.text: You've found the room where Donnie believes he saw the old rare last. Now it's time to see if you can help Donnie find it.How to play:- Walk around the room and type * near the different furnis to lift them and see if the rare is hidden underneath one of them.- You have 1:30 minute to find it, but don't worry: when you're close to the last place where Donnie saw the rare, you'll see a lightning bolt message indicating you're on the right track. Good luck!
24june01.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june02.text: Donnie's exhibition plans have grown more complex than he initially expected. He now needs help collecting the blueprint pieces for a time machine he's looking to build to go back in time and get the rare he's so desperetaly looking for.How to play:- Walk around the game area and step on the blueprint pieces. There's a total of 8 pieces you need to collect.- Watch out for the Frank statues and ghost, if they catch you you'll lose.- You have 2 minutes to complete the game. Good luck!
24june02.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june03.text: It's time to navigate the chaos of the maintenance room to chase and catch the elusive components Donnie needs to build the time machine.Items to catch:- 2 gears- 2 springs- 2 gauges- 2 leversh2. How to play:- Keep your focus on the game, every few seconds one of the listed pieces will appear in the room and your goal is to try to be the first person who catches them.- There's 4 new badges up for grabs if you manage to catch all the items. - Once you've collected the 4 badges, make sure to wear them to get access to access to a secret room where an additional prize has been placed.
24june03.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june04.text: You've got the Time Machine ready. Now, it's time to power it up by completing this quest!
24june04.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june05.text: You've managed to make the time machine work and now you've made your way to the past. It's time to help Donnie find the rare he's needs for his exhibition.How to play:- Step 1: Stand on the tile next to Donnie and listen to what he has to tell you.- Step 2: Use the mannequin to hide behind it as you try to reach the switch next to the curtains. You can only move to 2 tiles at a time.- Step 3: Watch out for the red lights, if you are "caught" by one of them you'll be taken back to the start. - Step 4: Double-click on the switch and place the mannequin in front of the microphone.- Step 5: Go upstairs and switch on the lights (click on the dimmer while being next to it).- Step 6: Unblock the rare, by clicking on the tables and dividers, then click on it when it's in front of you.You have 3 minutes to complete the game. Good luck!
24june05.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june06.text: Well done! You've found Maude's Studio! Now it's time to get the floppy disk Frank is in dire need of and bring it back to him but be careful Maude has installed cameras and sensors everywhere in the room so you'll need to be careful.How to play:- Walk around the studio quietly, if you walk too fast and make too much noise, you'll get caught. - Keep a slow and steady pace to avoid the noise detector from reaching the red tile.- You need to find the 2 pair of keys placed in the room to open the rope dividers. Once you've found them, type * to collect them.- The last thing left to do is collect the floppy disk behind the black piano and make your way back to the starting point to leave the studio.
24june06.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24june07.text: You got the floppy disk Frank needed; now it's time to find out what's stored inside. Your last task before diving into the mystery behind Frank's obsession with this disk is to get his old computer working again.How to play:- Walk around the game area and head towards the blue toolboxes Frank needs to fix his PC.- To move, simply click on the green ball above your head towards the direction you want to go, and then click on the red ball when you want to stop.- You must collect 5 toolboxes in total to fix the PC and win the game. Good luck!
24june07.title: Habbo History Exhibition
24neon01.text:
The night sky glows with neon hues, but something feels off. You’re not sure how you got here, but there's no time to think. You and your friends are being hunted. Can you escape the threats before it's too late?

How to play:

- **Run away from the wolf** - If it catches you twice, you'll lose.
- **Grab a hammer** - Head to the toolbox and type * to pick up a hammer.
-** Break the yellow fence** - Go near the yellow fence and type ** to break it.
- **Avoid traps** - Cross over the fence and be careful of traps on the ground. Falling into them will cost you time.
- **Use the torch** - Find the torch, then click on it or type * to use it.
- **Race the wolf** - Now, it's time to beat the wolf in a race on the track!
-** Heal your wounds** -  First, go to the First Aid Kit. Click on it or type *grab* to heal the wounds you got while escaping.
-** Find the Silver Sword** - Locate the Silver Sword, click on it, or type *grab* to protect yourself from the werewolf.
-**Run to safety** - Once you're safe, run into the spotlight in the forest to win.
- You have 3 minutes to complete the game and outrun the werewolf. Good luck!
24neon01.title: Neon Nightmare!
24neon02.text:
Hexed Labyrinth

Step into the forest and search for the witch’s lair. With each step, you venture deeper into the unknown. Be sure to keep track of where you’ve been—you don’t want to lose your way.
Along the path, you’ll encounter mystic creatures who will help you uncover parts of a powerful spell. Write down each phrase they give you, and be sure to arrange them in the correct order for when the time comes to cast the spell.
24neon02.title: Neon Nightmare!
24neon03.text:
Graveyard Feast

Three of your friends have been captured by crazed zombies and your mission now is to lure them back into the Vampire Coffin. Once you’ve freed your friends, make your way to the door that leads to the forest to secure your victory. Can you outsmart the crazed zombies and make it to safety? 

How to play:

- Find the food that is the zombies' weakness.
- Approach the food and click on it to make the zombie follow you.
- Quickly lead the zombie towards the Vampire Coffin.
- After eliminating the zombie, go to the cage where your friend is trapped and click on the cage to rescue them.
- Once you've rescued all three friends, head to the door that leads to the forest to win the game!
24neon03.title: Neon Nightmare!
24neon04.text:
Prom Night Escape

It's Prom Night, and the whole crew is ready for an unforgettable evening. But Bonnie has something unexpected in store, and it might not be the night they were hoping for...

How to play:

- Use the water pump to fill up your water cup and help rescue your friends.
- With your cup full, head over to any fire that’s blocking the bots or your way.
- Step on the fire to put it out. It'll disappear when you do. Tip: Only worry about the fires that are actually in the way.
- After using your water, go back to the pump to refill your cup.
- Once all your friends are free and the path is clear, make your way to the hallway exit..
- You've got 2 minutes to finish up, so act fast!
24neon04.title: Neon Nightmare!
24neon05.text:
Basement: The Secret Hideout

Welcome to The Secret Hideout! In this mysterious underground lair, you'll need to **activate the quest** before unleashing the spell. Will the spell put an end to all this once and for all?
24neon05.title: Neon Nightmare!{image|url=web_promo_small/spromo_24neon04.png|align=right|hspace=10|vspace=0}h1. Prom Night EscapeIt's Prom Night, and the whole crew is ready for an unforgettable evening. But Bonnie has something unexpected in store, and it might not be the night they were hoping for...h2. How to play:- Use the water pump to fill up your water cup and help rescue your friends.- With your cup full, head over to any fire that’s blocking the bots or your way.- Step on the fire to put it out. It'll disappear when you do. Tip: Only worry about the fires that are actually in the way.- After using your water, go back to the pump to refill your cup.- Once all your friends are free and the path is clear, make your way to the hallway exit.- You've got 2 minutes to finish up, so act fast!
24stpatricksday.text:
Helping Leprechaun

The Leprechaun is mad because some elves found his pot of gold and stole it. The elves found a way to protect their land against all leprechauns, so he needs some help to get his gold back. Can you do it?How to play:

- - One at a time, you need to pick up 3 coins and bring them to the golden cauldron in the center.
- To collect and put the coins in the cauldron just say *** beside of it.
- Be careful, don't let any of the elves get near you or you'll need to start from the begginning.
- Every time you collect one of the coins, Charlie will chase you throughout the room, so you must be agile and move FAST!
- If you step in the mushrooms, you'll be frozen for 3 seconds.
- After collecting the 3 coins, get back to the start corner to win your prize.
- You have 60 seconds to complete the game.

Good luck!
24stpatricksday.title: St Patrick's Day
24winter01.text:
Winter is here, and what better way to recharge your batteries than in a mountain chalet, with a hot chocolate in front of the fireplace?

How to play:

- The aim of the game is to reproduce the 6 images (Christmas symbols) in the badges display.
- Take the teleporter corresponding to the badge you want to draw.
- When you're in the room, to start, move forward in the queue, then at the end of the queue (when you're the first player), click in front of you to sit down, and you'll be teleported.
- Your mission begins: you have 2 min 30 sec to reproduce the image!

To draw :
- Click on the color of your choice on the palette (12 colors + 1 white to erase), then click on the squares you wish to color on your platform.
- Once you've finished your drawing, click on the Finnish Forest Reindeer furni to validate it.
- If you've made a mistake, a message will appear and you'll be able to fix it if there's time left.
- When you won all the 6 badges, return to the Hall and sit on a chair in front of the Chocolate stand to get the bonus badge. If you've missed any badges, a message will tell you which ones are missing.

PS : If you want to watch your friends play, say *look*

Good luck!
24winter01.title: Winter in Colors
24xmas01.text:
Gloria's Christmas Rescue!

Well done! You’re halfway through the maze! Next, you’ll need to find the levers that will light up the glowing balls. Once all the balls are glowing, step on the tiles at the end of the street to activate the teleport and move on to the next room.

Good luck!
24xmas01.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
24xmas01B.text:
Gloria's Christmas Rescue!

You’ve made it to the room where the evil elf is holding Gloria. To free her, you’ll need to defeat him in a battle!

How to play:

- Step on the purple tile to activate a power-up effect.
- Avoid all the attacks ElfoBomb is throwing your way.
- Make your way to the end of the street and stand in front of ElfoBomb to weaken him until he loses all his life points.

Good luck!
24xmas01B.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
24xmas02.text:
Help save neighbor Phil!

Phil was garderning while all of a sudden a fierce snowstorm has buried him under a thick blanket of snow. Unfortunately, we haven’t been able to gather any information that could lead us directly to him. However, we managed to locate a phone that can receive his signal by following the arrows. Can you save our good neighbor Phil?

  How to play:

- Follow the arrows to locate the phone
- Check each numbered locations to see if you can get Phil's signal.
- When you've found a signal, report the number to the location where you find the signal and help us rescue Phil.
- You have 1:30 minutes to complete the game and save Phil. Get your gloves ready and start searching for Phil!
24xmas02.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
24xmas03.text:
It's time to help Timothy cook Xmas Dinner!

Ready for some Habbo Xmas Crush? Tie on your apron, preheat the oven and let the festive culinary adventure begin. Will you be able to find the correct ingredients for Timothy's Xmas dinner?

How to play:

- Combine 3 or more ingredients for the recipe by clicking on the item you want to move and click again where you want to change it.
- Trees can be destroyed ONLY by combining them with other furni (they can only be destroyed if you use e.g. 3 flours + 1 tree)

Points:

three of a kind -> 3 points
four of a kind -> 6 points
five of kind -> 9 points
broken tree -> 5 extra points
You need to win 110 points to complete the game.

- You have 1:30 minutes to complete the game and save Christmas dinner. Good luck!
24xmas03.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
24xmas04.text:
Shopping for the perfect gifts

It's already Xmas and Timothy hasn't got any presents yet. Can you help him this last minute to rush to the store and get him the ultimate perfect gift?

How to play:

-  Step 1: First you need to get some money. Collect 20 credits in the Shop.
- Step 2: You need to control the robot and defeat the opponents who are throwing stones. Using the < and > buttons to move and the middle button to attack. When you defeat your opponents, you will receive the badge. Good luck!
24xmas04.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
24xmas04B.text:
Holiday Prep Party!

Help Timothy and Gloria set up for a very special Christmas!

How to play:

- At the start of the game, click on the block above either Timothy’s or Gloria’s head to choose who you want to help.
- Once you’ve chosen your character, click in front of the travel trunk and then on it to collect the Christmas tree decorations.
- Next, stand in front of the ladder, then click on the tree to start decorating. You’ll need to decorate it 5 times to make it look perfect.
- After the tree is decorated, it’s time to set up the Christmas dinner. Go to the pantry, take a plate, then bring it to the table. Repeat this process until the entire table is set.
- Once everything is ready, your friends will arrive at the party. Congratulations, you’ve won the game and earned your prizes!
24xmas04B.title: Twelve Tasks of Xmas!
25Olympus01.text:
Welcome to the Trials of Olympus!
Face the legendary challenges of the gods! Defeat the resurrected creatures and prove your strength in honor of Zeus. Only the worthy can endure each stage and complete the ultimate trial!

How to play?

- Pull the lever at the entrance to join the queue and start the trial.
- Attack the resurrected creatures by clicking on them or by pressing F.
- Overcome the waves of enemies.
- Clear each stage and unlock the divine powers granted by Olympus.

Game Dynamics

- Click on Zeus’s Lightning to gain godly powers for a short time.
- Open Pandora’s Box to gain +1 Life.
- When you click on a resurrected creature, your character automatically turns towards it and throws ice.
- If there are mobs between you and the target, the ice will not reach them.
- Projectiles have no limit.
- At the end of each stage, you gain +1 Life. When you reach the Hercules Stage, you gain +3 Lives.
- By clicking on yourself, you can view your Life, Score, and Kill stats.
- Score resets each time you are eliminated, but your Kill count remains permanent.
- Additionally, if you are eliminated during the Hercules Stage, you will have the option to restart directly from there when you re-enter.

Olympus Quests

- As you progress, new quests will be unlocked.
- You can track your progress from the Quests menu.
- Clear every stage, face Champion Hercules, and claim victory in the name of Zeus.
- Complete all the trials and prove yourself as a true hero of Olympus!
25Olympus01.title: Trials of Olympus
25SID01.text:
Before you can become an official member, you must pass a security test. Are you good enough to join them? Make sure to pass the test and show them you're a real SID expert! 

How to play:

- Test your knowledge by answering the true/false questions. Click on the color tiles to submit your answer.
- Once you've shown you are a true expert, you will be sent on a mission to save the leaked files from falling into the wrong hands. 
- Second mission is to save the network from the dangerous viruses. Fight the zombies by clicking on them to shoot or using the "*" key to attack. 
- While waiting for the anti-virus to install, you need to hold off waves of enemies and prevent the system from being overwhelmed. 
- In the final challenge a massive wave of virus attacks is happening. Make sure to survive for 30 seconds by either eleminating as many threats as possible or dodging them.
- You have 1:45min to complete the game. 

Good luck!
25SID01.title: Safer Internet Day 2025
25battle01.text:
h1.  Welcome to the Battle Ball challenge! 

Jump into the arena and try to lock more tiles than your opponent before time runs out. Use power-ups to mess with your rival or boost your own game. You've only got 2 minutes—so move fast and think faster!

Can you take control of the board?

h2. How to play?
- Your goal is to lock more tiles than your opponent in just 2 minutes.
- To lock a tile, walk over it 3 times. You can also lock a full shape by walking around its outline—once that’s done, all the tiles inside will lock automatically!

h2. Power-ups
Power-ups will pop up randomly during the game. To use one, just pick it up and say *
Note: You can only hold one power-up at a time!

- Box of Pins: Drops 5 pins near you. If someone steps on them, they get stunned and lose points—so avoid them!
- Spring: For 5 seconds, every tile you step on locks instantly.
- Harlequin: Make your opponent colour tiles for you during 5 seconds.
- Flashlight: Lights up all the tiles in front of you.
- Cannon: Locks all the tiles in front of you—but stuns you after.
- Lightbulb: Lights up a bunch of tiles around you.
- Random: Gives you a surprise power-up from the list above.
25battle01.title: Battle Ball Showdown
25brazil01.text:
You're a key part of protecting the amazing wildlife in this area. Some poachers have been spotted hurting animals and messing up the environment. We need your help to step in and save the Amazon!

How to play:

- Stand next to poachers to catch them.
- Step on fires to put them out.
- Say "*" near injured animals (look for the red arrow to know where to stand) to heal them.

You can do all of these at the same time—but to win, you’ll need to:

- Catch all 4 poachers
- Heal X injured animals
- Put out all the fires

And you’ve only got 1 minute and 30 seconds to do it! Good luck—and thanks for helping protect the Amazon!
25brazil01.title: Festa no Brasil!
25brazil02.text:
Sabores do Brasil!

Think you know Brazilian culture? It’s time to prove it!

Dive into an adventure where your knowledge of Brazil’s vibrant customs will be your best ally. But there's a twist — you’re not just answering questions… you're also on a delivery mission!Race through colorful neighborhoods delivering delicious dishes. Get those orders in fast — before Caramelo, the ever-hungry (and very sneaky) street dog, catches up to you!

How to play:

- Go to the arrow plates and start testing your knowledge about Portuguese onomatopoeia by answering the correct answers.
- Once you've answered all questions correctly, you will be teleported to the next game.
- Guide the motorcycle by clicking in front and behind of it. In each stage, you can only move in one direction. From each direction, a dog will chase you, so don't go too slow!
- Your goal is to reach ""Bar da Loura"" and make two deliveries within two minutes.
- The dogs / ball can hit you twice. If you're hit three times, you will return to the queue to try again!
- If you manage to do the deliveries and arrive home within two minutes you will complete the game. Good luck!
25brazil02.title: Festa no Brasil!
25brazil03.text:
Brazilian folklore

Step into the mysterious world of Brazilian folklore and meet the legendary trickster himself — Saci Pererê! With his whirlwind spins, single leg, and magical red cap, he’s always up to mischief… but today, you hold the power. Your mission? Steal his magical hat! But be warned, he won’t let it go without a fight.

Hold onto it, and Saci just might strike a deal. Complete his challenge, and he’ll grant you a favor in return...

h2. How to play:

- While Saci is sitting on the riverbank, you need to move forward when he's is not facing you. If you don’t sit (:sit) on the ground before he looks at you, Saci will catch you and you will be eliminated. Stand behind the Saci when he's not looking and click on his hat to steal it.
\- Now that you have Saci's hat, he desperately wants to grant you a favor to get it back. Use the arrow plates to guide Saci to the box and give his hat back.
25brazil03.title: Festa no Brasil!
25brazil04.text:
São João!

The festival has begun, and the square is buzzing with music, colors, and celebration!
 Help the locals prepare for the party, and earn your place as a true São João festival hero.

How to play:

- Step on the green circle to start dancing with the quadrilheiros!
 - Only step on the tiles when they’re green. If you step on a red tile or miss a step, you’ll lose.
- Once you finish dancing, head to the kissing booth to collect a letter, then go to Forró do Frank and find the right person to deliver it to by sitting on one of the chairs next to the bots.
- After delivering the letter, help the groom escape from the police by blocking their paths.
- When he’s safe, step on the ring plate to complete the game!
25brazil04.title: Festa no Brasil!
25coinrush01.text: Coin Rush!/n/nh1. Collect coins and avoid the raider ducks. Climb the leaderboard and gather yourself a fortune!/n/nh2. How to play?/n- Enter the game by using ticket machines/n- Use the switches to activate your ban-hammer power-up, now it's time to turn the tides!/n- Collect all bronze coins to clear the board!/n/nh2. Coin Rush Quests/nOnce you've progressed far enough in the game, more quests will become available./nSee your status in the Quests menu. Try to complete them all!/n/nh2. Leaderboard/nLand yourself on top of the leaderboard and get a badge!/nGet a top 5 spot on the leaderboard at any point and it's yours (requires a score of at least 2 000)./n
25coinrush01.title: Coin Rush
25fashion01.text:
Join the Fashion Elite!
Show off your styling skills and compete for a spot on the prestigious fashion team!  Pick the perfect outfit that matches the bot’s assigned theme in both style and color.

Are you ready to dazzle Luna Duck with your impeccable fashion sense and take your place among the best? The runway awaits! 

How to play:

- Choose the bag, shirt, and dress in the right style (Casual, Classic or Sport) and color.
- Use the arrow plates to browse options.
- Click on the small blocks (red, green, blue) to change colors.
- Click on the outfit to confirm your choice. 
- You'll have 2 min to complete the game.
Scoring system

- 2 Points: Outfit matches the theme.
- 1 Point: Color fits the theme.
- 1 Bonus Point: All three items are correct in style & color.

Winning the Challenge

- 6+ Points: You pass and join the fashion team!
- Less than 6 Points: Try again for another chance!
- Perfect 10: Achieve fashion mastery with a flawless score!
25fashion01.title: Fashion Easter!
25fashion02.text:
Step into the Sewing Studio!

In the fast-paced world of fashion, it's not just about creating designs—it's about keeping things running smoothly. Your mission? Get the sewing machines working to bring Luna McDuck’s latest collection to life!

Can you handle the pressure, fix the broken machines, and complete the collection before time runs out?

h2. How to Play:

- Approach a station and sit on white stool.
- Type "*" to try turning on the machine.
- If the machine is working, you'll get a thumbs up.
- If the machine is broken, it will start smoking and show a message indicating the problem.

Mini-Games:

- Each station has a unique mini-game that appears when a machine is broken.
- Two random mini-games will appear each round.
- Complete the mini-game to fix the machine.
- Once all machines are fixed and working, sit on the chair at the top desk (office area) to win!
25fashion02.title: Fashion Easter!
25fashion03.text:
The Battle for Luna begins!

In this high-stakes style showdown, you must assemble the perfect runway and claim victory! Hunt for the right stage elements, mix and match with precision, and create a breathtaking fashion spectacle that fits the theme.

Will your vision outshine the competition and win Luna's favor? Let the battle for fashion supremacy begin!

How to play:

- The bot will give you a theme and you'll have 2:30 mins to choose 8 matching furni items for the runway scene.
 - Use the arrows (< and >) to browse items and the pink button to select.
- Once your setup is complete, press the green button to finish the game. 
- If you completed the set with the correct items, you'll win your prize. 
- Use the red button to restart the game.
- Need a hint? Check the Builders Club Shop for guidance!
25fashion03.title: Fashion Easter!
25fashion04.text:
Welcome to the Final Showdown: The Runway Challenge!

The stage is set for the ultimate test of creativity. Two fashion powerhouses are vying for Luna's talents, and it's up to you to guide her models through the final obstacle course.

Will Luna choose sophistication or break the mold with bold fashion?  The runway is Luna's to conquer!

How to play:

- Guide the bot "Model" (near Luna McDuck) to the pink tiles at the end of the runway before your opponent.
- Use the arrow plates to control your model.
- Step on green tiles to earn a bonus and throw clothes onto your opponent’s path.
- Collect more green tiles for extra chances to slow down your opponent!
- Watch out—your opponent can throw clothes onto your path too! Stepping on them freezes you for 5 seconds.
- Reach the pink tiles first to win the game!
25fashion04.title: Fashion Easter!
25fastfood01.text:
Welcome to the Fast food game! 

The goal is simple: be the first player to successfully serve 6 plates of food to win the game!

How to play?

To serve a plate:
- Wait for the kitchen to prepare it. A green progress bar next to you shows when your plate will be ready.
- Click the drop button. Once the plate is ready, a drop button appears. Click it to release the plate, it will start falling toward the table, and the button will turn into a parachute icon.
- Deploy the parachute! Click the parachute button at just the right moment to safely land the plate on the table. If you're too late, the plate crashes and you’ll have to try again. If you’re on time, the plate lands safely and you earn 10 Fast Food points.If you’re the first to safely serve all 6 plates, you win the game, receive a badge, and earn an extra 100 Fast Food points!

Power-Ups

Power-ups give you an edge during the game! You can buy them with Fast Food points at the shop in the entrance area.
First-time players get 3 free uses of each power-up!

Big Parasol

Worried about timing your parachute just right? Use the Big Parasol! It lets you open the parachute at any time, even at the last second.
To use it: Click the Big Parasol power-up button before opening your parachute.

Rockets

Is someone way ahead of you? Time for sabotage! Use a Rocket to shoot down another player’s falling plate:
- Click the Rocket power-up button.
- Then click on a falling plate or the head of the player carrying it.
- You can only target plates that are currently falling.
- If successful, you earn 5 Fast Food points!

Bubble Shield

Someone targeting your plate? Protect it!
Use the Bubble Shield to block incoming rockets. Click the power-up button while your plate is falling — the shield will absorb the rocket and keep your plate safe!

Power-Up Shop

You’ll find the Power-Up Shop in the entrance area of Fast Food. Here you can buy more Big Parasols, Rockets, or Bubble Shields using the Fast Food points you earn while playing.

To purchase:
- Click the button of the power-up you want.
- Say how many you’d like to buy.
25fastfood01.title: Fast Food
25hween1.text:
The Last of Pixels

The Infected have taken over the hotel and chaos rules the halls. Guests have vanished, corridors are crawling with danger, and whispers say the cure is hidden deep inside. Only the bravest can fight through the madness, clear every obstacle, and recover it before the hotel is lost forever.
Your mission this time: help Joel survive! Hold off waves of zombies until the helicopter arrives to rescue you. Watch out, some zombies are stronger and need extra shots to take down.

Play Zone:

- You can only move along the street cross. Stay cautious, dodge zombies, and survive!

Time:

- Zombie waves spawn every 1 minute. The total time limit is 150 seconds. The helicopter will arrive in the last 15 seconds. Get on board fast before time runs out!

Ammo:

- Pick up ammo floating on the ground to get 20 bullets. Check the top right corner to see your remaining bullets and health bar.
- To shoot at a zombie, you just got to click on them.

Health:

- Look out for the health kit, which restores full health points. It spawns on the street cross every 25 seconds.
- Don’t let the zombies touch you or you’ll lose health points!
25hween1.title: The Last of Pixels
25hween2.text:
The Last of Pixels

The Infected have taken over the hotel and chaos rules the halls. You're looking for your brother Bobby and trying to deliver some medicine to Lara.
On your way there, you run into a horde of zombies, you're going to need to fight them of to reach Bobby and Lara .

h2. Level 1

Zombies are starting to spawn in, you'll need a weapon to defend yourself.

- Click on the axe to grab it.
- Once you've grabbed the broken axe, you can use it to stab the zombies in their heads by clicking on the zombies *when you're close to them*.
- Hit 10 level 1 zombies to move on to level 2.

h2. Level 2

A new type of zombie appears, these zombies have mushroom helmets on their heads, your broken axe won't be able to pierce those...

- You'll need to find a new weapon, click on the bow to grab it. 
- Once you've grabbed the bow, you can use it to shoot arrows at zombies by clicking on them.
- Hit 10 level 2 zombies to move on to level 3.

h2. Level 3

A third type of zombie appears, these have mushrooms growing out of their eye sockets, that's where you were aiming your bow...

- Click on the gun rack to grab a gun. 
- Once you've grabbed a gun, you can use it to shoot bullets at zombies by clicking on them.
- Hit 10 level 3 zombies to move on to level 4.

h2. Level 4

Huge zombies start appearing, their skin is extremely thick, your bullets won't pierce it...

- Click on the jerry can to turn it into a makeshift flamethrower. 
- Once you've grabbed it click a zombie to shoot a ray of fire towards them.
- Hit 10 level 4 zombies to have the teleporter to the next room appear.

Be brave and good luck on your journey!
25hween2.title: The Last of Pixels
25hween3.text:
The Pixel!

You’ve made it to the final part, now it’s time to hunt down the cure and wipe out The Infected who’ve taken over the hotel!
The game has 4 stages, each with 4 mini games. Complete a stage and you'll reach the room with the cure.

h2. How to play?

- Every 5 minutes, a teleport will appear and will send you to a random stage. You’ll have 12 seconds to step in, or you’ll be back in the queue.
- Before a mini game starts, you’ll hear a robot voice SFX. Turn on your sound so you don’t miss it!
- After finishing a mini-game, you’ll get 10 seconds to hop into the teleport to move to the next room. Miss it and you’ll be sent back to the castle.

h2. Quest:

Want an extra challenge? Complete all 4 stages to finish the quest.
Each stage you beat will reward you with duckets. Make sure you enable all 4 quests before you start playing!
25hween3.title: The Pixel!
25july01.text:
What’s the goal?
Cover the whole board with domino pieces. Each piece covers two numbers next to each other.

How to play:
- Look at the numbers on the board.
- Find two numbers that are next to each other (side by side or up and down).
- Click or pick those two numbers to make a domino.
- Remember, you can only use each pair of numbers one time (So if you use a domino with 1 and 3, you can’t use 3 and 1 again.)
- Keep doing this until all the numbers are covered.

Tips:
- Start with pairs that only show up once — those are easier!
- Watch which pairs you already used so you don’t repeat.
25july01.title: Dominosa!

Make sure you’re wearing your team’s badge before entering.Your mission in this room is simple: take down Rasta Santa.h2. How to play:- Enter the arena and start throwing snowballs at the bot.- Dodge the snowballs Rasta Santa throws back at you!- If you get hit 5 times, you’ll be removed from the arena, so stay sharp!h2. 25xmas3.text.title: Esophagor’s Hunger Trials
25xmas3.text:
Esophagor's Hunger Trials

Christmas is around the corner, and Esophagor is feeling hungrier than ever! Search the Money Trees for his favorite snacks and feed him before he throws a spooky holiday tantrum.

How to play:

- Look out for the Esophagor's Clues. At the start of every round, Esophagor will show you the furnis he wants to eat.
- Watch the Money Trees. From time to time, some of the trees will start to shake mysteriously.
- Destroy the Shaking Trees. Once you see a tree shaking, run to it and click it repeatedly until the health bar reaches zero.
- Collect the Dropped Furnis and Feed the Esophagor. Bring the correct ones to the Esophagor to please him, but beware: feeding him the wrong items will make him ANGRY!

Looking for an extra challenge?

Complete the quest to earn an additional exclusive badge!
25xmas3.title: Esophagor’s Hunger Trials
25xmas4.text: Welcome to the Christmas Village Maze!Explore the snowy village, stop by DJ Bling’s and Rasta Santa’s cottages, and track down all the hidden items for your team.Make sure you keep your team badge on at all times. There are 10 items to collect. Good luck, and try not to get lost!
25xmas4.title: Welcome to the Christmas Village Maze!
26dotsgame.text:
Welcome to Dots! Your goal is simple: connect dots of the same color to turn them into points and reach the target score before you run out of moves or time

h2. How to Play

- Click a dot, then connect adjacent dots (up/down/left/right) of the same color.
- Select at least 2 dots to score
- Press green to confirm (uses 1 move) or red to cancel.

New dots fall after each move. Every game starts with a random board.

h2. Limits:

- You'll have 30 moves
- The game lasts 2 min 30 sec
- Anti-AFK: 20 sec (10 sec warning)

Check out the scoreboard to see who's leading the game with the highest points! It’s all for fun and bragging rights only, there are no extra rewards for ranking positions.
26dotsgame.title: Connect the Dots!
26gamehall.text:
To escape the winter cold, how about a little getaway to the tropical jungle, surrounded by colourful wildlife?

h2. How to play:

If you have already played the previous versions, ‘Farm in Colours’ and ‘Winter in Colours’, the game is based on the same principle.

- Your goal is to recreate 8 different wild animal images in the badge display.
- Head to the huts at the top of the room, where you’ll find teleports leading to each game area.
- When you’re near a hut, click the ladder to climb up and take the teleport inside.
- Once you’ve collected all 8 badges, return to the Hall and sit on one of the chairs inside the small hut on the ground, near the little bridge, to receive a bonus prize.
If you’ve missed any badges, a message will let you know which ones you’re missing.PS : if you are stuck somewhere, say: **exit**
26gamehall.title: Wild Life in Colors!
26gameroom.text:
h2. How to play:

- To start, move forward in the queue. When you’re the first player, click the rock seat in front of you to be teleported to the drawing area.
- Depending on the image, you’ll have 2 minutes or 2 minutes 30 seconds to reproduce it.

h2. How to draw :

- Click a colour on the palette (12 colours + 1 white to erase), then click the squares you want to colour on your platform.
- Once you’ve finished your drawing, click the badge display near the game counter to submit it.
- If you’ve made a mistake, a message will appear and you’ll be able to fix it, as long as there’s time left.
PS : if you want to watch your friends play, say: **look**
Good luck !
26gameroom.title: Wild Life in Colors
26sidgame.text:
Test your knowledge and see if you can spot what’s Safe and what’s a Scam. Pay close attention, think smart, and prove you know how to stay safe online!

h2. How to play:

1) Lobby Room:

- Start by sitting on one of the sofas in the center of the lobby and listen carefully to the speeches given by Frank or Piccolo.
- Once all messages have finished, you will be automatically teleported to the next room.
2) Queue Room:

- There, use the classic BB ticket to join the queue and wait patiently for your turn.
3) Scam or Safe?:

- When you enter the game area, different scenarios will be acted out in front of you.
- After each one, Frank will ask “Scam or Safe?”
- Choose your answer by pressing the red button for Scam or the green button for Safe.
- Identify all 6 scenarios correctly in order to win, one wrong answer will get you eliminated, so think carefully!
26sidgame.title: Welcome to Safer Internet Day!

catalog.page.bundle_pirates.text_0: You'll get a pre-decorated room with 95 items and an exclusive Captain Effect and Badge. Wear the captain's badge and explore our public rooms throughout the campaign to collect prizes! Available throughout August.
catalog.page.bundle_pirates.text_2: Save over 50% when you buy from our Payment Page!
catalog.page.candyland15.text_0: Welcome to Santini Factory, where everything is edible - even the stuff that really shouldn't be...
catalog.page.easter14.text_0: From shape shifting wall pieces to cryptic teleports, the Isle of Lagomorph furni line is sure to keep you guessing! Nothing is as it seems on this mind-bending island...
catalog.page.gaming_furni.text_0: Use these simple Furni to bring extra spice to your Wired room. These are basic Furni, so you will still need Triggers, Effects and Conditions to make them work!
catalog.page.jellybean.text_0: The sound of birds chirping, the lush green colours…and the unsettling feeling that you're being watched! This eerie Easter bundle comes brimming with loads of furni and includes an AWESOME Badge!
catalog.page.movie_bundle.text_0: Draw the curtains, dim the lights and grab your popcorn…This pre-decorated Movie Room Bundle is packed to the rafters with everything the ultimate movie buff could desire. Includes an EXCLUSIVE badge!catalog.page.movie_bundle.text_1=What's included:
catalog.page.movie_furni.text_0: All the way from Habbowood...Everything you could need and more to create your very own movie magic in a home theatre! Available to buy until 30th Nov.
catalog.page.movie_furni.text_1: Click on an item for details:
catalog.page.movie_posters.text_0: From Dark Duck and the Ducket List, to Bobbaro and Get Frank - We have all the Habbo Classics! Each poster will be available for only 12hrs, so get them while they're hot...
catalog.page.movie_posters.text_1: Click on an item for details:
catalog.page.movie_rares.text_0: What do you get when you cross a christmas cracker with Duck? A Christmas Quacker! This Movie Madness Rare is available for a limited time, so make sure to watch the clock...
catalog.page.movie_rares.text_1: Rares are only available in the catalog for a short time, usually 6-8 hours.
catalog.page.palooza_festival.text_0: Create your own stage and outdoor festival area. We've got stages, fencing and even vending machines!
catalog.page.palooza_rares.text_0: Rare items will appear here for a limited time (usually 6-8 hours). Make sure to check often and check your email for updates.
catalog.page.pinatas.text_0: A piñata contains one of 5 possible collectible items, some more common than others. Each piñata has its own unique set of possible items and the contents of piñatas can not be found anywhere else in the catalogue. To open the piñata, you must use the Rainbow Piñata Stick effect and walk underneath it 100 times.
catalog.page.pirate_groups.text_0: Customize your Pirate Ship with Group Sails and Flags!
catalog.page.pirate_rares.text_0: Stock your ship with rare pirate loot. Rare items will appear here for a limited time (usually 6-8 hours). Make sure to check often and check your email for updates.
catalog.page.set_pirates.text_0: Build your pirate ship and assemble your crew. These accessories are the perfect compliment to a Captain's Bundle.
catalog.page.vault_party.text_0: Party like a Millionaire with your own walk-in Money Vault. This collection is for Habbos who like to show off in an extreme fashion.
catalog.page.wired_addons.text_0: Wired add-ons are here! Use these extras to upgrade your Wired builds: Random Effect, Unseen Effect, At least one condition is true, Cancel Move Animation, Move Users, Execution Limit and Movement Physics. Let's play!
catalog.page.wired_extras.text_0: We have some fantastic Wired extras for you - counters and antennas! We can't wait to see how you use these.
catalog.page.youtube_tvs.text_0: These aren't just any Tubes. The Video TVs allow you to select a video from one of our preset playlist. Visitors to your room will see a preview image and double click to view the video.

jul26soccer.text:
Bring white, blue and yellow balls to your own base, avoid red balls or kick those into the bases of your opponents.

Each ball has a different point value:

Red ball = -2 points
White ball = 1 point
Blue ball = 3 points
Yellow ball = 6 points

To win you need to collect at least 10 points within 2 minutes, only the player with the highest score wins, if there is a tie nobody wins!

You play as the bot of your own colour, you can control this bot by clicking where you want it to go.

nftoct01.text: h2. ...Habbo NFT's Zombie Run!Wait patiently in the queue. When the player queue is full, the host will start the game.When the game starts, you will be teleported to the entrance of the mansion and the countdown will begin! Enter the mansion via the attic door teleport, you will then have 5 minutes to find the exit within the mansion that leads to the winner's room (rumour has it that the rooms move around by themselves...).Not only will you face hidden traps within the mansion but once the counter in the entrance hits 4:30, the zombies will be unleashed upon you! Run through the mansion rooms away from the zombies! If they get close to you they'll eat you and kick you from the game! If you find the exit and reach the winner's room, flick the switch to receive a badge! If you're still within the mansion after 5 minutes when the counter ends, you'll be kicked from the game for a new game to start, good luck! (P.s. there's also another badge hidden in plain sight, will you risk your life for it?)

nov25_fruitchase.text:
How to play

Use one of the arrow pads or click around the Shoyru to change the direction the Shoyru is moving in. The goal is to collect as many Doughnutfruits as possible! But be careful, Blue Doughnutfruits are poisonous!

Fish Doughnutfruit: +5 points
Green Doughnutfruit: +10 points
Yellow Doughnutfruit: + 30 points
Icy Doughnutfruit: +60 points
Golden Doughnutfruit: +150 points
Blue Doughnutfruit: GAME OVER

Avoid hitting the walls, bushes and your own eggs!

h2. Difficulty selection

You can choose between 3 difficulties:

Easy: The field contains no bushes
Normal: The field contains a simple bushes maze
Hard: The field contains a harder bushes maze

To choose your difficulty, click the corresponding Shoyru within 15 seconds of entering the game room:

Easy: Blue
Normal: Yellow
Hard: Red

nov25_petpetherder.text: The Esophagor is starving. Rumor has it that pets make it ill, but desperation seems to have set in—Babaas are on the menu and you need to rescue them! How to play Click to move your Poogle. Retrieve and bring Babaas to the pen before the Esophagor catches them! Use open paths on the edges to teleport across the field! Grab Unguberries for a speed boost and Sniddberries to stop the Esophagor and Babaas for a moment.

nov25_potatocounter.text: *How to play*Count potatoes that fly across the game field. Don't count the bad, green potatoes!After you've seen the potatoes, you have 10 seconds to write your answer in numbers.Complete all game quests to claim yourself a badge!

quiz.HabboWay1.answer.0.0: You  are not happy because the odds are not in your favour!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.0.1: You  know it  is not allowed so you spam the room until the room gets closed - using clones if needed...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.0.2: You call on a Moderator and go around the Hotel looking for other exciting games. Placing bets can get you into trouble.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.0.3: You place bets and hope you win, you always wanted to be rich quick!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.1.0: You sell the old Habbo account on Ebay and buy Credits with the money.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.1.1: You sell the Furni in the Marketplace to get Credits for your HC membership.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.1.2: You swap your Habbo account with someone who needs Furni, but doesn't want to be HC anymore.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.1.3: You "borrow" your parents' Credit Card and use it to buy Credits and a dune buggy... whatever that is.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.2.0: You fight back by trash talking the Habbo 10 times worse.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.2.1: You call your mom and tell her to stand up for herself.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.2.2: You ignore him, and avoid telling your mom, because you know she'd totally go Chuck Norris on his butt...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.2.3: You call on a Moderator because this is clearly a Yo Momma emergency!!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.3.0: The 5 most beautiful rooms of the Hotel!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.3.1: The legendary "Opium den" - only a very few Habbos know about it. It's very exotic.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.3.2: This trophy you received for winning last year's Duck Funk contest
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.3.3: A room where you cybered all night long, for the price of only 3 Plasto chairs.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.4.0: You accept and agree to come to him first every time he needs help from now!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.4.1: You say thanks, but no thanks! As a Habbo Helper you help everyone equally... for free!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.4.2: This Habbo is trying to corrupt you! You ask for a Moderator to ban him immediately.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.4.3: You ask for a bigger reward...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.5.0: You feel offended and angry, and start trash talking the Group to anyone who will listen.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.5.1: You alert moderators immediately, because you feel that the Group goes against the Habbo Way.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.5.2: You create an anti-gay group and invite *them* to join *you*.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.5.3: You recognize that the invite was a gesture of friendship and you are free to accept or decline as you wish!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.6.0: You call a Moderator to ban the Group's admins, because tricking people is definitely not the Habbo Way!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.6.1: Hah... Good one. You won't be falling for that again...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.6.2: You keep on waving - and spamming! Maybe they'll change their minds if you pester them.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.6.3: You plan your revenge against this Habbo Group for a number of years, amassing a small fortune and political power in the process, and then, when they least expect it, you strike!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.7.0: You report the Habbo as a pedophile immediately.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.7.1: You refuse. ANY sexual innuendo is strictly forbidden in Habbo!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.7.2: You tell the Habbo you think s/he is ugly, and that you would never be caught in a "Kissing Booth" with them!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.7.3: You find out that the "Kissing Booth" is quite innocent and decide to join your new friend!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.8.0: You take part in the conversation, because you know that in Habbo it's okay to share opinions as long as you don't dish out insults!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.8.1: You decide to blackmail the Group's owner, if s/he pays you 10 Club Sofas, you won't report them to a Moderator...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.8.2: We don't talk about politics in Habbo, you call on a Moderator to delete this thread immediately!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.8.3: You jump into the conversation and reply to everyone in caps that THEY ARE WRONG AND YOU ARE RIGHT AND THAT'S THE END OF IT!!!
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.9.0: You call a Moderator. This Habbo is clearly the victim of harassment.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.9.1: It's all his/her own fault. If a Habbo is dumb enough to post real life photos of themselves, they should suffer the consequences.
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.9.2: You comment on the thread and try to calm the other Habbos down, the photos weren't THAT bad...
quiz.HabboWay1.answer.9.3: You realize that it's a picture of your great-great-great grandfather, and get very, very confused...
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.0.0: Habbos create some amazing games and competitions, and we want you to join in and have fun! However, not all game room owners are as honourable as we'd like them to be, which is why we advise you to never pay to enter a game!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.0.1: Being obnoxious will never result in anything, except perhaps tendinitis from too much spamming... We advise you to walk away while your dignity is still intact!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.0.2: Being mean and sarcastic will never result in anything, except maybe life as a stand-up comedian... Walk away, while you still have your dignity and the chance of a better future!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.0.3: Unfortunately, real life never works out like it does in the movies (and there's only one Clooney). Walk away with while you still have your dignity! ;)
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.1.0: Not such a good idea... because selling a Habbo account on Ebay is illegal and everyone involved will be banned.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.1.1: Letting your friends "use" your account is never a good idea, no matter how small the task they want to complete it. You never want to find yourself in this position- it's more uncomfortable than trying to perform the Nutcracker in the back of an Audi.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.1.2: Swapping your account means giving someone else access to your personal information, which in turn will get very messy, very fast. Stay safe, never share or swap your Habbo!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.1.3: In this case, "borrowing" is the same as stealing, and in Habbo we do not tolerate fraudulent or unlawful behaviour. HC is great fun, but hardly worth breaking the law for!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.2.0: Don't lose your cool! Trash talkers love to get you in trouble by upsetting you... By ignoring them, they'll just look dumb all on their lonesome!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.2.1: Do you think your mom really (like really) cares? Nah, we didn't think so either... :) Let them trash talk, when you ignore them, they'll just look dumb to everyone else in the room.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.2.2: We really don't think your mom would be *that* concerned.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.2.3: We suspect that "Yo Mama" is a pretty fierce lady that would never be bothered about some groundless accusations in Habbo. And she'd be right. Stay cool just like Yo Mama!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.3.0: As a Habbo Helper you recognise that it's not the size of a person's ankles that matters, but the size of their hearts.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.3.1: Habbo does not condone the use of illegal drugs, and we hope that you'll help us take that stand and be good role models to new Habbo players by giving them a great first impression of our Hotel!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.3.2: As a Habbo Helper you know that it's not about you, but about showing someone else a great time and introducing them to all the fun things that the Hotel has to offer!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.3.3: Cybering is strictly forbidden, you should not be doing it either.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.4.0: As a Habbo Helper you are devoted to giving great help to anyone who needs it, and you're happy to do it for free! Don't let your standards slip...
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.4.1: As a Habbo Helper, you know that doing a good deed is it's own reward. Besides, how much Brown Plasto do you really need anyway??
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.4.2: Though we certainly frown upon corruption, we trust that in this situation, you'd be able to explain that you and others like you, are always happy to help, and that they shouldn't have to pay!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.4.3: Well, well, well, someone got greedy! Habbo Helpers are there to guide anyone who needs it - for FREE! ;)
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.5.0: Just because you receive a Group invite, doesn't mean you have to accept it. More importantly, it does not excuse or allow for a hateful response. In Habbo, this will not be tolerated.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.5.1: In Habbo, you are allowed to be who you are, as long as you do not harm others. A Group that is pro gay youth is in no way deemed harmful. You can decline or accept, but there would be no need to alert a Moderator in this case!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.5.2: In Habbo we do not allow hateful language or acts targeting race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality, nationality or political beliefs. By creating such a Group, you would be in violation of those rules.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.5.3: There's enough groups in Habbo to cater to (almost) every interest or hobby, there's no need trying to change the focus on one group to suit your own needs.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.6.0: While we realize that it hurts to be the victim of a prank, we hope that you are able to laugh it off and move on with a new lesson learned -- you'll definitely know better next time... right?? ;)
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.6.1: If you can't laugh at yourself every now and then, how can you expect others to laugh with you?
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.6.2: Spamming only leads to you being ignored and eventually muted, and probably also tendinitis. We advise you to laugh it off and move on -- pranks happen, you'll know better next time :)
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.6.3: Wow. This sounds very intense. For the sake of your own sanity, and quite possibly hygiene, we advise you to forget about it and move on... before it's too late! :o
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.7.0: While we advise you to always be cautious, you shouldn't be afraid to flirt and get to know others! The "Kissing Booth" is an example of a Furni that you might have some innocent fun with, however, if you find yourself in a situation that is clearly threatening and not innocent, you should call on a Moderator immediately.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.7.1: While we do not allow vulgar or obscene behaviour in Habbo, we do want you to be able to have some flirty fun! The "Kissing Booth" is a perfect example of a Furni that is just-for-fun, however, if you don't want to join this Habbo, you can absolutely choose not to.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.7.2: Trash talking others says a lot more about you than the other person. If you didn't want to go into the "Kissing Booth" Furni, you could just say "No, thanks!" No hard feelings...
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.7.3: Sorry, but the Kissing Booth only sits two Habbos. This is certainly not a "more the merrier" situation!
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.8.0: In Habbo we allow opinions - and difference of opinions! We do not, however, allow for more than three levels of irony, it just gets too confusing...
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.8.1: In Habbo we allow opinions - and difference of opinions! We do not, however, allow bribery...
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.8.2: In Habbo we allow opinions - and difference of opinions! We do not, however, allow hateful language that targets race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality or political beliefs, nor do we allow comments that are abusive or denigrating.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.8.3: Eeeasy there, soldier. In Habbo we allow opinions - and difference of opinions! Spamming the conversation will only serve to make you wildly unpopular and your opinions will likely be ignored.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.9.0: While we advise you to be careful regarding your personal information, there's nothing wrong with admitting that you are a fan of Saved By The Bell.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.9.1: While we do advise you to be careful about revealing personal information about yourself, nothing excuses harassment. Call a Moderator, s/he would take such a call very seriously.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.9.2: While we appreciate you trying to calm down the mob, this is clearly a case of bullying and harassment, and we would want you to alert a Moderator about this situation immediately.
quiz.HabboWay1.explanation.9.3: Related or not, we do not accept bullying or harassment in Habbo! Your great-great-great grandfather deserves better than this. Call a Moderator!
quiz.HabboWay1.question.0: You find a room where somebody is  placing bets, what do you do?

reward_track.introduction.info: Complete tasks to earn points and unlock rewards
reward_track.introduction.name: Introduction Track
reward_track.introduction.task.buy_catal: Open the catalog and pick an item. Ducket furni are a good first choice, since you get free duckets while playing the game.
reward_track.introduction.task.change_mo: Update the motto on your profile
Click on your Habbo in a room to edit your motto. Be creative!
reward_track.introduction.task.change_ou: Open the clothes editor to update your outfit. Time to build a personality here!
reward_track.introduction.task.chat_with: Say something in rooms with other players
Join a lively room and talk with the people there.
reward_track.introduction.task.close_lov: Lock a love-lock furniture with a friend
Find or place a love-lock furniture (you get one for free through this reward track), invite a friend, and confirm it together.
reward_track.introduction.task.create_ro: Open the Navigator and create a room to start building your own new space.
reward_track.introduction.task.dance_in_: Start dancing while you are in a room
Click on your Habbo and click "Dance" to get those pixels moving. Good vibes will do the rest!
Place pet food in your room and let your pet eat it.
reward_track.introduction.task.follow_fr: Follow a friend to the room they are in
Open your Friends list and use the "Follow" button to join them.
reward_track.introduction.task.give_resp: Click on another Habbo and give them respect.
reward_track.introduction.task.go_swimmi: Swim in a room with water
Search for pool rooms, then get into the water and swim around!
reward_track.introduction.task.grab_drin: Get a drink from hand item furniture
Look for a hand item furni (you get a fridge for free during this reward track) and use it to get a hand item (any will do).
reward_track.introduction.task.level_pet: Spend time caring for pets. Feeding, training, and scratching them helps them improve.
reward_track.introduction.task.make_frie: Send friend requests to other players
Use the "Find Friends" button or meet players in rooms, then add them as friends if you like em!
reward_track.introduction.task.move_furn: Move furni around in a room
In your room, select furniture and move it to make the room feel right. You can press and hold the "ALT" key to move furni around more easily!
reward_track.introduction.task.pet_a_pet: Give some attention to pets in the hotel :)
Find a room with pets (you get one for free through this reward track) and give them some love by scratching them!
reward_track.introduction.task.place_bui: Place Builders Club furniture from the warehouse
Open the Builders Club warehouse (the toolbar item with the yellow helmet) in a room and place furniture from it.
reward_track.introduction.task.place_fur: Place furni from your inventory into a room
Go to your room, open your inventory, and place some furniture.
reward_track.introduction.task.publish_p: Take and publish a camera picture.
Open the camera, take a picture, and publish it for others to see. Make sure to include the friends you just made!
reward_track.introduction.task.replenish: When you have no respect left, use the replenish option so you can keep giving respect to other players.

safety.booklet.frame.title: Stay safe in Habbo
safety.booklet.ok.content: You've now read the safety instructions, keep these rules in mind and you'll get the best out of Habbo!
safety.booklet.ok.title: Thanks For Reading!
safety.booklet.page.0.description: You never know who you're really speaking to online, so never give out your real name, address, phone numbers, photos and school. Giving away your personal info could lead to you being scammed, bullied or put in danger.
safety.booklet.page.0.title: Protect Your Personal Info
safety.booklet.page.1.description: Keep your Skype, MSN, Facebook details private. You never know where it might lead you.
safety.booklet.page.1.title: Protect Your Privacy
safety.booklet.page.2.description: Just because everyone else seems to be doing it, if you're not comfortable with it, don't do it!
safety.booklet.page.2.title: Don't Give In To Peer Pressure
safety.booklet.page.3.description: Never meet up with people you only know from the internet - people aren't always who they claim to be. If someone asks you to meet with them in real life say "No thanks!" and tell us, your parents or another trusted adult.
safety.booklet.page.3.title: Keep Your Pals In Pixels
safety.booklet.page.4.description: If someone is making you feel uncomfortable or scaring you with threats inside Habbo, report them to us immediately using the Help Button.
safety.booklet.page.4.title: Don't Be Scared To Speak Up
safety.booklet.page.5.description: You have no control over your photos and webcam images once you share them over the internet and you can't get them back. They can be shared with anyone, anywhere and be used to bully or blackmail or threaten you. Before you post a pic, ask yourself, are you comfortable with people you don't know viewing it?
safety.booklet.page.5.title: Ban The Cam
safety.booklet.page.6.description: Websites that offer you free Credits, Furni, or pretend to be new Habbo Hotel or Staff homepages are all scams designed to steal your password. Don't give them your details and never download files from them; they could be keyloggers or viruses!
safety.booklet.page.6.title: Be A Smart Surfer

sept24brainteaser.text:
Let's test our brains!

Do you like puzzles? You are going to love this game! Combine blocks until you get a white block. You can see the sequence of colors on the left.

How to play:

- Use the arrows to move the blocks and combine blocks with the same color.
 - Move the blocks so the ones with the same color get together, merging them.
- A new block will appear if the last move moved any blocks or matched them. The new block can be yellow or orange, with a higher percentage of yellow.
- Keep merging to get higher number of points possible.
- You have 4 minutes to play.

Get *2000 points* to win the Brain Teaser Player badge.
Get *4000 points* to win the Brain Teaser Master badge.
The badges will be delivered after the time runs out.

Good luck!
