sid2024.text:
Learning more about Cyberbullying

Strap in for a wild ride through the virtual cosmos as you embark on a mission to rescue the internet from the clutches of one notorious villain: the malevolent Deepfake. It's time to don your digital superhero cape, unleash your meme-tastic powers, and join forces with a squad of cyber-savvy comrades to safeguard the online realm. Get ready to LOL in the face of danger, ROFL your way through challenges, and GIF your all to save the day. 
In this pixelated battleground, where memes clash and GIFs dance, your ultimate weapon against the forces of Deepfake is not just a joystick or a keyboard - it's knowledge! To emerge victorious you'll need a brain as sharp as a cyber katana. Arm yourself with insights on cyberbullying, outsmart the trolls with your wisdom, and decode the secrets of digital empathy. Whether you're a seasoned cyber warrior or a novice in the realm of online etiquette, the only way to conquer this game is by embracing the power of knowledge about cyberbullying. So, brush up on your digital ethics, wield your intellect like a magic wand, and let the battle for a safer internet begin!

To help you in your journey, here are some facts about cyberbullying:

*Harassment* - Is sustained and intentional Bullying composed of abusive or threatening messages that can severely affect a person's mental well-being.
*Dissing* - Spreading cruel information to ruin someone's reputation or relationships. Usually the bully knows or has a personal relationship with the victim.
*Outing or Doxing* - Is the act of revealing sensitive or personal information (messages, photos, videos, etc) about someone without their consent, aiming to cause them harm or humiliation.
*Cyberstalking* - The use of technology (most often, the internet) to make someone else afraid or concerned about their safety. This is already a crime in a lot of countries worldwide and can have tragic consequences.
*Exclusion* - Deliberately excluding an individual from online activities, groups, or conversations to isolate and ostracize them.
*Impersonation* - Pretending to be someone else online with the intent to deceive or harm their reputation.
*Fake profiles* - Usually created to hide the attacker's real identity with the intention to bully others without revealing who they are.
*Frapping* - It happens when someone steals your account and starts to impersonate you online posting inappropriate content. A fake profile can also be used for the same thing.
*Trolling* - Trolling is when a person intentionally tries to incite negative reactions by posting inflammatory comments online. Trolling bullies tend to be more interested in creating conflict and don't have a personal relationship with their victims.
*Flaming* - Intentionally posting false, harmful, or defamatory information about someone with the aim of damaging their reputation.
*Cyberbullying by Proxy* - Enlisting others to engage in cyberbullying on behalf of the instigator, often without the target's knowledge.
*Catfishing* - Happens when online identities are stolen to recreate social networking profiles for deceptive purposes. Happens when online identities are stolen for deceptive purposes.
*Trickery* - Involves gaining the victim's trust so that secrets can be shared publicly online later.

tutorial.step.roominfo.description: Want to know more about the room you are in? Press here to find out more. If this is your room, you can also edit certain things like the room's name, who is allowed in, and more.

tutorial.step.rooms.description: Can you imagine a place with infinite rooms and infinite ways of having fun? Well, that's Habbo! There's rooms for hanging out, gaming, roleplaying... Like I said, the possibilities are endless. Most rooms are made by players - you should check some out and try creating one yourself!

tutorial.step.settings.description: Here you can find the settings for the game and for your account.
tutorial.step.settings.title: Settings
tutorial.step.shop.description: Here you can find everything that's for sale. If you're looking for something that's not in the Shop or you're feeling thrifty, make sure to check out the Marketplace. Habbos list their items there and you might be able to get a good deal!

tutorial.step.subscriptions.description: This is where you can see your memberships status. HC stands for Habbo Club, and membership gives you lots of clothing and hairstyle options among other cool perks. The golden builder's hat stands for Builders Club and it gives you access to a huge amount of loanable furni and other perks specific to building.

wiredchests.capacity_info.desc: The chest capacity states how full a chest can get:
wiredchests.capacity_info.rule_1: 1. When the capacity is exceeded through a Wired transaction, all furni/credits that enter the chest will be sent to the owner of the chest.
wiredchests.capacity_info.rule_2: 2. In case of credits, the excessive credits will be sent to the Earnings window under a category "Wired chests", which is invisible if there is nothing to claim.
wiredchests.capacity_info.rule_3: 3. The maximum capacity for Credit Chests is 5.000, for Furni Chests it is 1.000. This can be upgraded.
wiredchests.capacity_info.rule_4: 4. You can set the capacity to 0 to make all earnings go directly to your inventory/earnings.

wiredchests.lock_info.desc: Locking is a safety mechanism for Wired Chests:
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_1: 1. When a chest is locked, Wired can not interact with the chest.
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_2: 2. When a chest is locked, users with Wired modification rights can't withdraw or deposit from the chest,   except for the Chest owner.
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_3: 3. You have the option to automatically lock the chest when you leave the room. Use this in games where supervision is required.
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_4: 4. If you have the option to auto-lock enabled, you need to manually unlock the chest when entering the room.
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_5: 5. There's an option in the Wired Menu to unlock or lock all your chests in the room. You can also open this menu with the command ":wired".
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_6: 6. Both the room owner and chest owner can lock chests. Only the chest owner can unlock chests.
wiredchests.lock_info.rule_7: 7. Chests are locked by default when placed in a room.
wiredchests.lock_info.title: Locking system

woa_room1.text:
Part I - The Ambassador Role

Aetheryre

Greetings Adventurer - I am Frostgrove. You have been tasked by the King to retrieve and deliver precious runestones, which could only be found where goblins are, to him. The journey ahead is a long and arduous one, so you will want to make sure you have packed your bandages, stocked up on your potion supply, and studied your compass closely before setting off.
I can teleport you to the first level, but you'll need to attune to the aetheryte by naming, slowly and clearly, any one of the current Ambassadors. Unsure who they are? Check out the Ambassadors' at your service help desk article by heading to help.habbo.com.

Room Instructions

- Say any of the usernames of one current member of the Ambassador Team.

- If you are unsure, visit the "Ambassadors at your Service" article on help.habbo.com.

 - Enter the forest ring teleporter to begin your journey.
woa_room1.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room10.text:
Oaks Cellar

Helping to store the Tavern's extensive stock, the cellar is also a place where bar staff can relax and take a well deserved break.

Room Instructions

- Complete the short telephrase to continue.

- Use French Pancake to repeat the questions.

- There is no penalty for failing to complete the questions correctly, simply try until successful.
woa_room10.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room11.text:
Forest of the Dead

The road to the catacombs is dangerous, weaving through a nearly permanently darkened forest that hides some dangerous and spooky creatures and provides a reminder of those that are less fortunate and did not make it through...

Room Instructions
- Phase 1: Walk towards the entrance of the witch's cabin when the Scarecrows aren't watching, and enter using the Lost Souls Portal.
- Use the Lost Souls Portal at the entrance to the Witch's Cabin to move to the next location.
- Historical trivia and other quirky facts about the team will be shown as you progress through the room.
- Failure will require you to reattempt the level until successful completion.
- Phase 2: Once you've escaped the Witch's Cabin, you'll appear in front of the Catacombs. Enter the Reaper Teleport to continue your journey.
woa_room12.text:
Witch's Cabin

You stumble headfirst into the inside of the Witch's cabin, and try as you might, you cannot seem to figure out a way to escape. It's lucky that the Witch isn't home at the moment, which buys you some time to explore. Perhaps with some quick reading and clever thinking you'll figure out a spell that can get you out of here...

Room Instructions
- Explore the room to find switches which will tell you the one of the three different portions that make up the spell required to escape the cabin.
- There are five hidden switches in the room, three of them will give you a piece of the spell.

- Once you have correctly activated the three legitimate switches, you can use the coloured tile to say the spell and escape the witch's cabin.

- The coloured tile will show as red when you have done enough to activate the spell.

- Use the Smelly Cheese to collect your reward.
woa_room12.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room13.text:
Inside The Catacombs

Remembering those that came before us is a huge part of the culture and religion of the region, and although there are different ways of saying goodbye, one thing that is universal no matter the method of remembrance is providing a place for quiet contemplation and reflection. You sense a distant humming sound and see sparks buzzing in the distance... What could it be?

Room Instructions
- You must find the correct teleport to progress.

- There are 11 teleports moving around the catacombs on their own (ooooh spooky!), but only one brings you to the next room.

- The spell you've learnt from the witch cabin might aid you by stopping the teleport for a short time to make things easier. Can you remember it?

- You can continue to attempt this level until successful!
woa_room13.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room14.text:
Time Machine

Unstable and potentially dangerous to others, Wizards have mastered the art of time travel. Requiring a specialized device and a lot of magical energy, it is possible to travel backwards or forwards in time. Explore some of the future real world cities and pay homage to past team members.

Room Instructions
- Listen to the bot story that provides important information you will need later on.

- Once finished, use the Teleporter on Good Side Floor Tile to continue to the next level.

- Use the Rose Gold Button to collect your reward when coming out from Teleporter on the Bad Side Floor Tile.

- Use Forest Ring Teleport to move to the next location.
woa_room14.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room15.text:
Central London

You find yourself travelling forward in time to central London to interact with previous members of the UK/EU Ambassador team. Home to many famous landmarks: Big Ben, Downing Street, and Hyde Park are some of those located within the heart of London and represent the overwhelming majority of UK/EU team members. Despite that, we did have one EU member (Delfinlskare) who was Swedish! We thank everyone for the past service and want to remember their time on the team.

Room Instructions
- Meet the previous UK/EU team members and interact with them by using the switches located nearby.

- The bots have standard phrases but only a few will give a hint as to the correct code word(s) to move on to the next location.

- The correct codeword changes frequently, so keep trying until you are successful.
woa_room15.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room16.text:
Niagara Falls

You find yourself travelling forward in time to Niagara Falls to interact with previous members of the NA Ambassador team. The natural wonder of the world spans the borders of the province of Ontario, Canada and the state of New York, U.S.A. We thank everyone for the past service and want to remember their time on the team.

Room Instructions
- Meet the previous NA team members and interact with them by using the switches located nearby.

- The bots have standard phrases but only a few will give a hint as to the correct code word(s) to move on to the next location.

- The correct codeword changes frequently, so keep trying until you are successful.
woa_room16.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room17.text:
Uluru and Gardens by the Bay

Your next stop is in outback Australia to explore the sacred indigenous site of Uluru (also known as Ayers Rock) located in outback Australia. Finally, you visit central Singapore to see the amazing Gardens by the Bay, which are part of a huge nature park with light up trees! We thank everyone for the past service and want to remember their time on the team.
Room Instructions

- Meet the previous OC team members and interact with them by using the switches located nearby.

- The bots have standard phrases but only a few will give a hint as to the correct code word(s) to move on to the next location.

- The correct codeword changes frequently, so keep trying until you are successful.
woa_room17.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room18.text:
Part V - Knowledge Test

Road to Castle

Huge and imposing, the castle is home to The King, the highest ranking humanoid creature in the world. While inside the King's court is heavily defended by the Kingsguard, outside the castle walls is a much more dangerous place... will you run into bandits or thieves who want to steal your loot?

Room Instructions
- Phase 1: Sneak past the bandit to complete the room.

- Be sure not to move while the Bandit is looking in your direction or you'll get mugged and have to restart the level!

- Failure to complete this level will require you to restart until successful completion.

- Phase 2: Once you've made it past the Castle Dungeon, you'll appear in front of the Castle. Use the Forest Ring Teleport to continue your journey.
woa_room18.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room19.text:
Castle Dungeon

Screams of pain ring out from the castle's dungeon, which holds thieves, murderers, and anyone else who dares to break any of The King's laws. You are stuck here, awaiting certain death, unless you figure out the correct way to escape.

Room Instructions
- To escape, you must correctly guess one of the names of furni located on the upper level of this room.

- The answer will randomly cycle between a predetermined number of items every 3 seconds, so it will not always be the same.

- Failure to say the right furni name will result in you having to continue to name furni items to successfully escape the room.
woa_room19.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room2.text:
Goblin Infested Forest

Goblins, collectively known as the goblin hood, favour money above all else. Shrewd and greedy, they behave like many of the trolls that can be often found inside the public rooms - with the exception that they are vastly more technologically advanced. This forest is patrolled by goblins, who will protect their stored inventions and treasures at all costs. Approach carefully and good luck...

Room Instructions

- Make it past the goblins and enter the cave (via the teleporter) to progress to the next level.

- OPTIONAL Use the hidden switch, if you can find it, to stop the goblins for a short time.

- Facts about the Ambassador role will be shown as you progress through the room. Pay attention, you might need this information later on.

- Failure will require you to start over to complete the level.
woa_room2.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room20.text:
Meeting The King

The King's throne room is enormous, with enough space for thousands of citizens to congregate to petition The King. Stand at attention, be respectful, and answer any of The King's questions to complete your journey.

Room Instructions
- Phase 1 Complete the telephrase questions successfully. If you're unsure, check the Ambassadors at your Service article (on help.habbo.com).

- Phase 2 Avoid the Knights guarding The King.

- You can reattempt Phase 2 as many times as needed to complete the level. You do not need to complete Phase 1 again each time.

- Once you complete both phases, use the Forest Ring teleporter to continue.
woa_room20.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room21.text:
Sephirot Tree

You hear birds chirping in the distance and see the flutter of beautifully coloured butterflies. Set amongst the backdrop of a gorgeous sephirot tree, you finally sense that you, at last, have a period of time to rest and relax. Will your journey continue? I suppose time will tell.

Room Instructions
- Use Enchanted Sword to collect your reward.

- Congratulations for finishing the entire event, we hope you enjoyed it!
woa_room21.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room3.text:
Goblin Cave

Although gifted engineers, goblins are just as comfortable living in more primitive places. In this case, they operate a cave network that is used to safely hide and store their riches, as well as interrogate and confuse their adversaries. If you're lucky enough to not get lost, maybe you'll find the information that you need to successfully escape the dark, dingy labyrinth.

Room Instructions

- Listen to the bot story that provides important information you will need later on.

- Once the story finishes, attempt to obtain the magically moving runestones by standing on one of the colored tiles when active (colored green).

- Failed attempts to catch the runestones results in no penalty, you can keep trying until you are successful.

- Use Smelly Cheese to collect your reward.
woa_room3.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room4.text:
Goblin Treasure Vault

Bacon, bands, benjamins, big bucks, cheddar, tenners, wad, gold, quid, and moolah - all slang terms for goblins' one true and unwavering motivation: money. The goblin treasure vault permanently stores their riches for countingand safekeeping.
The goblins aren't looking to hurt you, however, they just need to make sure you aren't planning on taking any of their moolah.

Room Instructions

- This level features a multiple choice telephrase that covers questions about the Ambassador role.

- Step on Color Tile to repeat the questions.

- Failed answers will time you out for a period of time, then allow you to continue guessing.

- Successfully complete all questions to complete the mini-game.
woa_room4.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room5.text:
Part II - Regional Ambassador Teams

Marketplace

A bustling bazaar of all kinds of knicknacks, you can get just about anything you need at any of the marketplaces dotted throughout the land. Whether it be fish, meat, or any number of weird and exotic vegetables, you can find some of the freshest and tastiest produce. All marketplaces strictly enforce bartering, so using your charm and assertiveness can easily net you the best deals. Every buyer is on their own, though, so be careful not to get scammed!

Room Instructions
The level requires you to follow the bot's instructions within a given timeperiod.

- Failure to complete all tasks within the provided time frame will result in you having to reattempt the level.

- The final step requires you to stand on the coloured tile and say *Pay*.

- Once finished, listen to the bot story which will tell you information you'll need later on.
woa_room5.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room6.text:
Seaport Room

Essential for trade, the seaport is used by fishers and traders alike and is the fastest way to transport vast quantities of goods between any of the land's marketplaces and villages. The port also provides some of the most rewarding work for citizens, offering opportunities for skilled craftspeople to repair, build, and work on ships and those less skilled to catch and sell seafood to earn their keep. But beware, there are pirates who are eyeing some hefty rewards looking to steal the runestones from you.
Room Instructions
- To begin the level, enter through the Attic Gate.

- You must avoid the incoming barrels for 60 seconds. The bot will announce when there is 30 seconds remaining.

- Failure will require you to start over to complete the level.

- Once complete, use the Forest Ring teleporter to continue.

- Use Lizard on a Stick to collect your reward.
woa_room6.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room7.text:
Part III - Ambassador Events

Village

Featuring a town square and serving as the main points for transportation for the region, villages are the place where everything happens. Packed with a myriad of shops that sell everything from expensive fabrics, to oddities and curious items from less travelled parts of the land, to the day-to-day necessities for the citizens that live and work in the village. Need to relax for a night, stay at any of the inns operating in the village or relax in one of the taverns and meet some of the village's most quirky characters.

Room Instructions

- Phase 1: Find the correct spade tile that will teleport to the Wizard Tower's entrance which is located to the left of the direction sign arrow. The starting spade banzai is to the left of the stable.

- You can continue to stand on spade banzai tiles so try as many times as required to complete Phase 1.

- Phase 2: Once you have completed the Wizard's Tower, you will appear outside The Bard Tavern. Enter the Conference Door teleporter to continue your journey.
woa_room7.title: World of Ambassadors
woa_room8.text:
The Bard

There's nothing better than a relaxing night spent in any of the taverns located throughout the village. They are the best place to hear rumours, meeting shady, sometimes "helpful" characters, and whittle the night away. Grab some ale, pull up a chair, and see what conversations, information, or favours come your way... you learned that there are potions in the tavern that could aid you on your journey ahead.
Room Instructions
- Listen carefully to Shelob the bartender. He will provide hints that will loosely correspond to one of the four coloured potions on the tables.

- You must decipher the hint and sit in the correct position within the specified timeframe to complete the level.

- Once finished, listen to the bot story which will tell you information you'll need later on.
woa_room8.title: World of Ambassadors

xmas25_icecream.text:
Ice Cream Machine 
 
 
 Select a difficulty, dodge scoops, and collect power-ups on your way to become an ice cream master! Move Lupe by clicking the green arrows or the playfield. Hitting a scoop or missing a power-up costs you a life and 5 points.

How to play

Click the Bushy Pine Tree to enter the queue. Then, click a Snowman inside the game room to choose your difficulty.

Survive the increasingly difficult rounds by clearing:
Easy - 100 scoops
Medium - 150 scoops on fast speed
Hard - 250 scoops on fastest speed

Points
Regular: +5
Strawberry Sauce: +10
Chocolate Sauce: +20
Caramel Sauce: +30

Power-ups
Strawberry (+100)
Fish Hat (+250)
Fire Fruit (+500)
Jonas Head (+1000)
Ice Crystal (Protection)
Revival Potion (+1 life)

wiredmenu.error_info.title: Wired Error Information
wiredmenu.error_info.0:
This error occurs when the maximum Wired usage limit (which can be observed in the "Monitor" tab) is about to be exceeded by a Wired execution.
When this happens, the execution of Wired will be cancelled, such that the Wired usage limit is never exceeded.

Reaching the execution cap too quickly may be a sign of an inefficient Wired setup.
If your Wired setup is not too complex, you should investigate how to improve the setup to avoid this error from unexpectedly happening. The Wired usage is a great indicator of your room's Wired complexity, and other factors (such as lag in the Habbo servers) are not at play.
wiredmenu.error_info.1:
Delayed Wired events happen when you execute a Wired effect that has a delay configured.
There is a limit to how many of these delayed Wired events can be awaiting execution at the same time, otherwise a smart setup with Wired signals could cause a memory leak in the Habbo servers.

In any normal scenario, it would be rare to receive this error. If for some reason you do, you may have made an error in your Wired setup. If you haven't made an error, you should transform your Wired setup to use Wired counters instead
wiredmenu.error_info.2:
This error occurs when the Wired engine is receiving a lot of instructions, but the Habbo servers can not keep up with it.
This is usually a sign of server issues, and may not necessarily have to do anything with your room.

If your room also gives the "MARKED_AS_HEAVY" warning, your room may be a contributing factor and you could look into making the Wired setup less complex
wiredmenu.error_info.3:
The Habbo servers are analyzing the time it takes to execute your Wired setup at all times, and may consider it to be a "heavy" Wired setup if certain boundaries are exceeded. What happens as a result, is that your room is treated slightly different to avoid it from interfering with other rooms in the hotel. There is no reason to panic as this is not an error, but just a warning. However, you shouldn't completely ignore it too.

What this means for a wired creator is:
- Ignore the message if Habbo is lagging, it may not be related to your wired setup.
- Ignore this message if your room is actually a complex wired room. It's just a notification in that case, so you're aware.
- If none of the above, and it's supposed to be a simple room, then you're doing something wrong and should probably improve the Wired setup.
wiredmenu.error_info.4:
This is an error that occurs when the Habbo server suspect your room from having malicious Wired intentions. For that reason, the exact criteria for when this happens will not be disclosed.

The penalty for this error is that Wired execution is halted for 10 minutes.
wiredmenu.error_info.5:
Recursive wired events happen when signals execute other Wired stacks in the room. It may do that 10, 100, or 1000+ times before actually concluding the Wired execution. If the Habbo servers analyze that this is taking too long, it will stop your Wired execution.

This Wired error rarely occurs, but it sometimes does when there is lag on the Habbo servers and the Wired room is either inefficient or complex.
In most cases, another Wired error will already have stopped your Wired execution before this error can occur.
wiredmenu.error_info.6:
This error occurs when you have given too many different Wired variables to a user or a furni. However, this limit is very high and is not something you should be reaching.
If you are reaching this limit, it may be a sign that you're trying to use variables in a repetitive or wrong way, to achieve a goal variables aren't fit for.

If you are trying to use Variables to store long lists of data for a user or furni, you should be aware that that is not possible and you may require a more creative solution to solve your problem.
If you are familiar with the concept of "bit operations" or are open to learn about it, you can use it to store more data on a single Wired variable (depending on the use case).
Wired variable values are 64-bit signed integer values, and bit operations are located under the advanced math operators.

26beachgame.text:
Summer vacation is here! Enjoy sunny days, sandy beaches, and Mediterranean vibes.

h2. How to play:

If you have already played the previous versions, ‘Farm in Colours’ and ‘Winter in Colours’, the game is based on the same principle.

- Your goal is to recreate 7 different wild animal images in the badge display.
- Take the different teleports leading to each game area.
- Once you’ve collected all 7 badges, return to the Hall and sit on one of the chairs, to receive a bonus prize.

If you’ve missed any badges, a message will let you know which ones you’re missing.

PS : if you are stuck somewhere, say: **exit**

Good luck!

jul26templex.text:
Complete quests and escape the labyrinth by finding the Key and the Exit, but watch out for the boulders! Getting hit loses you a life, and after three lives off you go. 
 
The labyrinth shifts each time you re-enter, so be ready to orient yourself again! 

h1. Instructions:

- Click on the rolling boulder to play. If game rooms are full, you are placed in a queue.
- Say * to mark or unmark the position you are in 
- There is a time limit of 20 minutes. Don't worry, your quests will remain active!

The game is open until Sunday 2 August, be sure to finish everything by then.
